Loss covers prompt tokens as well as the completion (labels unmasked), so val loss is a noisy proxy and not comparable across prompt formats.
Measured on a free Colab T4. Per PRD non-functional requirements, latency and cost from this tier are NOT reportable - those come from the rented A10G.
